## Topics

- **AI and its stakes** — economic, social and environmental.
- **AI project management for executives** — the phases of an AI project, from needs analysis to the technical solution and its deployment.
- **Needs analysis and AI solution design.**

## Format

Workshops are built around **serious games** designed for the purpose, followed by a debriefing on real cases. They have been run at the MIAI Summer School, Université Grenoble Alpes events on professional training, and the Cap'IA day, among others.

At the MIAI Summer School, the workshop *Introduction to AI System Project Management* combines an interactive game covering the life cycle of an AI project with a **data challenge** on predicting the production cost of plastic injection moulds from a real industrial dataset.
